[[File:Stat Restore Pot Share icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Stat Restore Pot Share''' is a [[Lunar spell]]. When it is cast on any non-barbarian [[potions|potion]] that restores (not [[boost]]s) stats which is in the caster's inventory, it causes the caster to administer 1 dose of the potion to each player (up to 4 if used on a full vial) in a 5x5 square area around the caster (including standing on the player's square) if they have [[Accept Aid]] turned on, or are a member of your [[Group Ironman Mode|Ironman Group]]. Potions that boost stats can be shared using the [[Boost Potion Share]] spell.

As with all [[Lunar spells]], the quest [[Lunar Diplomacy]] must be completed to cast this spell. A hidden effect is that doses of potion are only used up on other players; with the caster receiving a "free" dose. If the caster has only 1 target, both will receive the restoration for the cost of a single dose. This makes the spell invaluable for 2 person teams using [[prayer potion|prayer]] or [[super restore]] potions. Players casting Stat Restore Pot Share purely to gain [[experience]] should cast the spell with only one other person so as to maximise the experience.

Despite [[Run energy]] not being a stat, this spell can be used to share [[Energy potion]]s and [[Stamina potion]]s. It cannot share a [[Menaphite remedy]] however, despite primarily being used to restore stats.

==Compatible potions==
The following potions can be shared using this spell:

{|class=wikitable
!colspan=2|Potion
|-
|{{Plinkt|Energy potion}}
|-
|{{Plinkt|Prayer potion}}
|-
|{{plinkt|Restore potion}}
|-
|{{Plinkt|Super energy}}
|-
|{{Plinkt|Super restore}}
|-
|{{Plinkt|Sanfew serum}}
|-
|{{Plinkt|Stamina potion}}
|}

Several potions cannot be shared using this spell despite restoring at least one stat: these include [[ancient brew|ancient]] and [[forgotten brew]]s, [[Armadyl brew|Armadyl]], [[zamorak brew|Zamorak]], and [[Saradomin brew]]s, [[menaphite remedy]], [[surge potion]]s, and [[prayer regeneration potion]]s. Despite all other forms of run energy regain being sharable, [[extreme energy potion|extreme energy]] and [[extended stamina potion]]s cannot be shared.
